help.stereoWidth.title: Stereo Width
help.stereoWidth.description: Scales the difference between left and right channels: 0% is mono, 100% preserves width, and higher values widen stereo.
help.stereoWidth.usage: Adjust stereo music or headphone listening.
help.stereoWidth.warning: Wide settings can exaggerate out-of-phase material; mono content does not become surround.
help.bass.title: Bass
help.bass.description: Boosts low frequencies with a low-shelf filter, adding weight and impact.
help.bass.usage: Music, movies and games needing more low end.
help.bass.warning: Boosts consume headroom and may mask speech or increase limiter activity.
help.clarity.title: Clarity
help.clarity.description: Adds a broad presence boost centered at 2.4 kHz, making voices and detail more prominent.
help.clarity.warning: High settings can sound sharp; this is EQ, not voice isolation.
help.spatial.title: Spatial / Immersion
help.spatial.description: Planned feature. HRTF, virtual surround, upmix and room modeling are currently bypassed; this preview adds no spatial DSP.
help.spatial.warning: Only stereo width and basic crossfeed work in this build.
help.frequency.title: Frequency
help.frequency.description: Sets the center frequency for a bell filter, or the transition/cutoff frequency for shelves and pass filters.
help.frequency.usage: Choosing which part of the spectrum to shape.
help.frequency.warning: Changes near the top of the spectrum are limited by the active sample rate.
help.gain.title: Gain
help.gain.description: Boosts or cuts the selected bell or shelf band in decibels.
help.gain.warning: Boosts consume headroom. Gain has no effect on low-pass or high-pass filters.
help.q.title: Q
help.q.description: Controls filter bandwidth or resonance. Higher Q makes bell adjustments narrower and changes shelf/pass transition shape.
help.q.usage: Targeted corrections or broader tonal shaping.
help.q.warning: High Q can produce ringing or resonant peaks.
help.filter.title: Filter type
help.filter.description: Selects bell/peak, low shelf, high shelf, low pass or high pass for this band.
help.filter.usage: Choosing a local adjustment, broad shelf or frequency cutoff.
help.filter.warning: Changing type changes how Frequency, Gain and Q shape the response.
help.lowShelf.title: Low Shelf
help.lowShelf.description: Boosts or cuts frequencies below the transition frequency.
help.lowShelf.warning: Large boosts may mask mids and reduce headroom.
help.highShelf.title: High Shelf
help.highShelf.description: Boosts or cuts frequencies above the transition frequency.
help.highShelf.warning: Boosts can emphasize hiss or harshness.
help.peak.title: Bell / Peak
help.peak.description: Boosts or cuts a region around the selected frequency; Q sets its width.
help.lowPass.title: Low Pass
help.lowPass.description: Attenuates frequencies above the cutoff; Q affects resonance.
help.lowPass.warning: May remove useful detail. Gain is unused.
help.highPass.title: High Pass
help.highPass.description: Attenuates frequencies below the cutoff; Q affects resonance.
help.highPass.usage: Reducing rumble or excess low end.
help.highPass.warning: May thin voices and bass. Gain is unused.
help.bandEnabled.title: EQ band enabled
help.bandEnabled.description: Includes this band in the equalizer response when checked.
help.bandEnabled.warning: Disabling one band leaves the other processing active.
help.crossfeed.title: Crossfeed
help.crossfeed.description: Directly blends left and right channels, reducing stereo separation. At maximum, the channels converge to mono.
help.crossfeed.warning: Frequency-dependent crossfeed is planned; this blend can narrow positional cues.
help.compressor.title: Compressor
help.compressor.description: Uses a stereo-linked peak envelope to reduce levels above the threshold, making dynamics more even.
help.compressor.warning: Strong compression can flatten impact or cause pumping.
help.threshold.title: Threshold
help.threshold.description: Sets the envelope level above which compression reduces gain. Lower values affect more of the signal.
help.threshold.warning: Only affects sound when the compressor is enabled.
help.ratio.title: Ratio
help.ratio.description: Sets compression strength above the threshold. 1:1 applies no reduction; higher ratios restrain loud passages more.
help.ratio.warning: High ratios reduce dynamic contrast; compressor must be enabled.
help.attack.title: Attack
help.attack.description: Sets how quickly the compressor envelope responds to rising peaks.
help.attack.usage: Balancing transient punch and level control.
help.attack.warning: Fast attack can soften impacts; slow attack lets peaks through. Compressor must be enabled.
help.release.title: Release
help.release.description: Sets how quickly the compressor envelope falls after a peak, allowing gain to recover.
help.release.usage: Matching compression recovery to the material.
help.release.warning: Short times can pump; long times may suppress following sounds. Compressor must be enabled.
help.makeup.title: Makeup Gain
help.makeup.description: Adds gain after compression when the compressor is enabled.
help.makeup.warning: Extra gain can increase final limiter activity.
help.inputHeadroom.title: Input Gain / Headroom
help.inputHeadroom.description: Attenuates input before EQ and other processing to leave space for boosts.
help.inputHeadroom.usage: Preventing boosted signals from driving the limiter heavily.
help.inputHeadroom.warning: More attenuation lowers listening level; it does not repair clipped source audio.
help.outputGain.title: Output Gain
help.outputGain.description: Adjusts processed level after compression and before the final safety limiter.
help.outputGain.warning: Boosts may cause limiter reduction; bypass uses its own fixed reference.
help.limiter.title: Limiter
help.limiter.description: The final stereo-linked sample-peak limiter protects output with a 0.98 ceiling (about −0.18 dBFS).
help.limiter.usage: Containing output peaks; always retained during bypass.
help.limiter.warning: Heavy reduction can affect dynamics. True-peak oversampling is not implemented.
help.bypass.title: Bypass
help.bypass.description: Fades to the original input at a fixed −6 dB reference, retaining final limiter protection.
help.bypass.warning: This is not loudness-matched A/B; level differences can influence comparisons.
help.sampleRate.title: Sample Rate
help.sampleRate.description: Shows the endpoint format in samples per second. The prototype requires matching stereo float32 source and output rates.
help.sampleRate.warning: This is a readout, not a resampling control; higher rates do not restore missing source detail.
help.channels.title: Channels
help.channels.description: Shows the endpoint channel count. The current route processes stereo (two channels).
help.channels.warning: Multichannel virtualization and upmix are bypassed.
help.buffer.title: Buffer
help.buffer.description: Shows the render stream latency plus the duration of its allocated buffer.
help.buffer.warning: Not an adjustable buffer or measured end-to-end latency.
help.latency.title: Latency
help.latency.description: Buffer telemetry estimates output stream latency and allocated render-buffer duration.
help.latency.usage: Understanding part of the playback delay.
help.latency.warning: Capture, queue and device delays are not fully measured; no end-to-end latency readout exists.
help.callback.title: Callback time
help.callback.description: Shows elapsed time for the latest audio event handling pass, including capture, DSP and render work.
help.callback.warning: Not an average, DSP-only timing or end-to-end latency measurement.
help.glitches.title: Glitches
help.glitches.description: Counts capture packets flagged by WASAPI as data discontinuities.
help.glitches.warning: A counter is diagnostic; it does not measure audible severity. Reset on route start.
help.underruns.title: Underruns
help.underruns.description: Counts render fills with too few queued frames; missing samples are replaced with silence.
help.underruns.warning: Also may occur during startup. Reset on route start.
help.overruns.title: Overruns
help.overruns.description: Counts oversized capture packets or queue overflow that discards queued audio.
help.overruns.warning: Can cause discontinuities; reset on route start.
help.source.title: Capture source
help.source.description: Selects the endpoint whose playback is captured by loopback.
help.source.usage: Routing audio from a source endpoint to a separate output.
help.source.warning: Source and output must differ and have matching stereo float32 formats.
help.output.title: Output device
help.output.description: Selects the endpoint that plays the processed loopback signal when the route starts.
help.output.warning: Changing selection does not restart an active route; start the route with the desired endpoints.

help.modeMusic.title: Music
help.modeMusic.description: Uses a tonal EQ curve with bass and presence shaping; Hi-Fi and Classical variants flatten EQ and disable those boosts.
help.modeMusic.usage: A starting point; choose a variant and adjust by ear.
help.modeMusic.warning: Presets use current stereo DSP, not HRTF or surround. Browser preview does not process audio.
help.modeMovie.title: Movies
help.modeMovie.description: Uses bass and presence shaping; Night Mode enables stronger compression and reduces bass.
help.modeMovie.usage: A starting point; choose a variant and adjust by ear.
help.modeMovie.warning: Presets use current stereo DSP, not HRTF or surround. Browser preview does not process audio.
help.modeGaming.title: Gaming
help.modeGaming.description: Uses a detail-oriented EQ curve and wider stereo; immersive variants add width and bass.
help.modeGaming.usage: A starting point; choose a variant and adjust by ear.
help.modeGaming.warning: Presets use current stereo DSP, not HRTF or surround. Browser preview does not process audio.
help.modeFPS.title: FPS
help.modeFPS.description: Reduces low-frequency EQ and emphasizes upper mids for positional detail; bass enhancement is off.
help.modeFPS.usage: A starting point; choose a variant and adjust by ear.
help.modeFPS.warning: Presets use current stereo DSP, not HRTF or surround. Browser preview does not process audio.
help.modeVoice.title: Voice
help.modeVoice.description: Reduces low frequencies and emphasizes speech presence; the base preset enables compression.
help.modeVoice.usage: A starting point; choose a variant and adjust by ear.
help.modeVoice.warning: Presets use current stereo DSP, not HRTF or surround. Browser preview does not process audio.
help.modeStreaming.title: Streaming
help.modeStreaming.description: Uses mild EQ and presence shaping; Live Stream enables compression.
help.modeStreaming.usage: A starting point; choose a variant and adjust by ear.
help.modeStreaming.warning: Presets use current stereo DSP, not HRTF or surround. Browser preview does not process audio.
help.modeCustom.title: Custom
help.modeCustom.description: Starts with flat EQ and editable stereo processing settings.
help.modeCustom.usage: A starting point; choose a variant and adjust by ear.
help.modeCustom.warning: Presets use current stereo DSP, not HRTF or surround. Browser preview does not process audio.
